name: chip-group
summary: Filter chips that widen to make room as a check mark draws itself in.
props: Plain strings or objects with label, icon, count and per-chip disabled.
Controlled selection (or use defaultValue). Single mode reports [] or [value].
Single mode: tapping the selected chip clears it.
Selected look: filled accent, accent border with a faint tint, or soft accent tint.
One horizontally scrolling row instead of wrapping.
Scroll-row edge padding that bleeds into your screen gutter.
Morph a check in front of the label when selected.
Dims every chip and blocks presses (or set disabled per option).
Style for the wrapping row (the ScrollView when scrollable).
behavior: Tap to select. In single mode, tapping the selected chip clears it unless deselectable is false. Short chips pad their hit area to 44pt.
Selection springs the check, width and colours together, and chips squish while pressed.
Chips are radios in single mode and checkboxes in multiple mode, with checked and disabled state.
